mapper.select: /*selectCommonMpIvInvoiceDetailIVPopInfo*/ SELECT MAX(POHD.PO_NO) AS PO_NO -- 0 , MAX(IVHD.INV_NO) AS INV_NO -- 1 , MAX(( SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = ( SELECT DECODE(B.PROCESS_TYPE, '2', B.WAREHOUSE_CODE,B.BUYER) FROM ICOMPODT B WHERE B.BUYER = POHD.BUYER AND B.PO_NO = POHD.PO_NO AND ROWNUM = 1 ))) AS BUYER_NAME -- 2 , MAX(DECODE(CMP.AGENT_OPEN_FLAG,'N','코리아이플랫폼(주)',(SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = IVHD.AGENT))) AS AGENT_NAME -- 3 , MAX((SELECT MAX(RD_DATE) FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = POHD.BUYER AND PO_NO = POHD.PO_NO)) AS RD_DATE -- 4 , MAX(IVHD.INV_DATE) AS INV_DATE -- 5 , MAX(( SELECT MAX(DECODE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = DECODE(DT.PROCESS_TYPE,'2','KRKORE0068',POHD.BUYER) AND TYPE = 'C012' AND CODE = DECODE(DT.PROCESS_TYPE,'2','001',POHD.DELY_TO_LOCATION)), 0, POHD.DELY_TO_LOCATION, ( SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = DECODE(DT.PROCESS_TYPE,'2','KRKORE0068',POHD.BUYER) AND TYPE = 'C012' AND CODE = DECODE(DT.PROCESS_TYPE,'2','001',POHD.DELY_TO_LOCATION) ))) FROM ICOMPODT DT WHERE BUYER = POHD.BUYER AND PO_NO = POHD.PO_NO)) AS DELY_TO_LOCATION -- 6 , MAX(IVHD.REMARK_INV) AS REMARK_INV -- 7 , MAX(DECODE(CMP.AGENT_OPEN_FLAG,'N','KRKORE0001',IVHD.AGENT)) AS AGENT_CODE -- 8 , MAX(PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO) AS LEGACY_PO_NO , MAX(POHD.PURCHASER_ID) AS PURCHASER_ID , MAX(IVHD.LEGACY_IV_SERIAL) AS LEGACY_IV_SERIAL , MAX(DECODE(PODT.PROCESS_TYPE,'2',PODT.WAREHOUSE_CODE,PODT.BUYER)) AS TR_BUYER , MAX(P.QRY_STR1) AS QRY_STR1 , MAX(P.QRY_STR2) AS QRY_STR2 , MAX(P.QRY_STR3) AS QRY_STR3 , MAX(P.QRY_STR4) AS QRY_STR4 , MAX((SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'C019' AND CODE = IVHD.PARCEL_COM_CODE)) AS PARCEL_COM_CODE , MAX(IVHD.PARCEL_INV_NO) AS PARCEL_INV_NO FROM ICOMIVHD IVHD , ICOMIVDT IVDT , ICOMPOHD POHD, ICOMCMPY CMP, ICOMPODT PODT , ( SELECT Y.QRY_STR1 , Y.QRY_STR2 , Y.QRY_STR3 , Y.QRY_STR4 , X.SLG_ID , X.DEFAULT_RPT_URL FROM ( SELECT 'P06-0000002' AS SLG_ID -- ID 하드코딩 , 'RD_06_S_001_83' AS DEFAULT_RPT_URL --디폴트 유알엘 하드코딩 , 추후 변경 /kr/epro/buy/sheet/inv_prn.jsp FROM DUAL --한건도 조회되지 않는 것 방지 ) X , ( SELECT B.COL01_DATA QRY_STR1 , B.COL02_DATA QRY_STR2 , B.COL03_DATA QRY_STR3 , B.COL03_DATA QRY_STR4 , A.SLG_ID FROM BNTSLGDEF A, BNTSLGIMP B WHERE 1=1 AND A.SLG_ID = B.SLG_ID --default url을 가져오기 위해 아우터조인 AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN A.OPEN_DATE AND A.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.OPEN_DATE AND B.CLOSE_DATE AND B.COM_CODE = #{buyer} -- 고객사 회사코드 AND A.SLG_ID = 'P06-0000002' -- ID하드코딩 ) Y WHERE 1=1 AND X.SLG_ID = Y.SLG_ID(+) ) P WHERE IVHD.BUYER = #{buyer} AND IVHD.SELLER = #{seller} AND IVHD.INV_NO = #{inv_no} AND IVHD.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND IVHD.INV_NO = IVDT.INV_NO AND IVDT.BUYER = POHD.BUYER AND IVDT.PO_NO = POHD.PO_NO AND IVDT.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND IVDT.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND IVDT.PO_SEQ= PODT.PO_SEQ AND IVHD.STATUS <>'D' AND IVDT.STATUS <>'D' AND POHD.STATUS <>'D' AND PODT.STATUS <> 'D' AND POHD.BUYER = CMP.COM_CODE GROUP BY IVHD.INV_NO

CODE = IVHD.PARCEL_COM_CODE)) AS PARCEL_URL , MAX(DECODE(PODT.PROCESS_TYPE,'2',PODT.WAREHOUSE_CODE,PODT.BUYER)) AS TR_BUYER , MAX(P.QRY_STR1) AS QRY_STR1 , MAX(P.QRY_STR2) AS QRY_STR2 , PARCEL_INV_NO , MAX((SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C012' AND COMPANY_CODE = PODT.BUYER AND CODE = (SELECT PR.DELY_TO_LOCATION FROM ICOMPRDT PR WHERE PR.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND PR.PR_NO = PR.STATUS != 'D')) AS RECIPIENT_PHONE , MAX((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMIVDT WHERE BUYER = IVHD.BUYER AND INV_NO = IVHD.INV_NO AND STATUS != 'D')) AS INV_CNT , MAX(IVHD.INV_AMT) AS INV_AMT FROM ICOMIVHD IVHD , ICOMIVDT IVDT , ICOMPOHD POHD, ICOMCMPY CMP, ICOMPODT PODT , ( SELECT Y.QRY_STR1 , Y.QRY_STR2 , Y.QRY_STR3 , Y.QRY_STR4 , X.SLG_ID , X.DEFAULT_RPT_URL FROM ( SELECT 'P06-0000002' AS SLG_ID -- A.OPEN_DATE AND A.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.OPEN_DATE AND B.CLOSE_DATE AND B.COM_CODE = #{buyer} -- 고객사 회사코드 AND A.SLG_ID = 'P06-0000002' -- ID하드코딩 ) Y WHERE 1=1 AND AND POHD.BUYER = CMP.COM_CODE GROUP BY IVHD.INV_NO

/*selectCommonMpIvInvoiceDetailIVPopList*/ SELECT B.BUYER_ITEM_NO -- 0 , B.DESCRIPTION -- 1 , B.SPECIFICATION -- 2 , NVL(B.ITEM_QTY,0) AS ITEM_QTY -- 3 , NVL(A.INV_QTY,0) AS INV_QTY -- 4 , A.UNIT_MEASURE -- 5 , A.UNIT_PRICE -- 6 , NVL(B.ITEM_QTY,0)*A.UNIT_PRICE AS PO_AMT -- 7 , B.REF_PR_NO -- 8 , B.BYIT_COMORG_CODE -- 9 , B.CONTRACT_NO -- 10 , B.CONTRACT_SEQ -- 11 FROM ICOMIVDT A, ICOMPODT B WHERE A.INV_NO = #{inv_no} AND A.SELLER = #{seller} AND A.BUYER = #{buyer} AND A.STATUS != 'D' AND A.INV_QTY > 0 AND B.STATUS != 'D' AND B.SELLER = A.SELLER AND B.BUYER = A.BUYER AND B.PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND B.PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ ORDER BY 1, 2

/*selectCommonMpIvInvoiceDetailIVPopList_v2*/ SELECT B.BUYER_ITEM_NO -- 0 , B.DESCRIPTION -- 1 , B.SPECIFICATION -- 2 , NVL(B.ITEM_QTY,0) AS ITEM_QTY -- 3 , NVL(A.INV_QTY,0) AS INV_QTY -- 4 , A.UNIT_MEASURE -- 5 , A.UNIT_PRICE -- 6 , NVL(B.ITEM_QTY,0)*A.UNIT_PRICE AS PO_AMT -- 7 , B.REF_PR_NO -- 8 , B.BYIT_COMORG_CODE -- 9 , B.CONTRACT_NO -- 10 , B.CONTRACT_SEQ -- 11 , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMATCH WHERE DOC_NO = B.IMAGE_KEY) AS IMAGE_KEY_CNT , B.IMAGE_KEY , B.PO_REMARK ,(SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = B.BUYER AND TYPE = 'Z014' AND CODE = B.ACCOUNT_TYPE) AS ACCOUNT_NAME -- 계정명 ,(select DECODE(COUNT(*),0 , '', 1 , DECODE(B.BUDGET_DEPT ,MAX(F.CODE1), MAX((SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 T WHERE T.COMPANY_CODE = B.BUYER AND T.TYPE = 'C001' AND T.CODE = F.CODE1)) ,''), MAX((SELECT MAX((SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 T WHERE T.COMPANY_CODE = B.BUYER AND T.TYPE = 'C001' AND T.CODE = F.CODE1)) FROM ICOMCOD3 E , ICOMCOD3 F WHERE E.BUYER = B.BUYER AND E.CODE1 = B.BUDGET_DEPT AND E.TYPE = 'DTOD' AND E.BUYER = F.BUYER AND E.CODE2 = F.CODE1 AND F.TYPE = 'DTOA' AND F.CODE1 = B.BUDGET_DEPT AND DECODE(F.FLAG,'Y',DECODE( B.BUDGET_DEPT ,F.CODE1,'N','Y'),'N') = 'N' AND F.CODE2 = B.ACCOUNT_TYPE)) ) FROM ICOMCOD3 E , ICOMCOD3 F WHERE E.BUYER = B.BUYER AND E.CODE1 = B.BUDGET_DEPT AND E.TYPE = 'DTOD' AND E.BUYER = F.BUYER AND E.CODE2 = F.CODE1 AND F.TYPE = 'DTOA' AND F.CODE2 = B.ACCOUNT_TYPE ) BUDGET_DEPT_NAME -- 예산부서 ,DECODE((SELECT AGENT_OPEN_FLAG FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = B.BUYER), 'N', 'KRKORE0001', (SELECT POHD.AGENT FROM ICOMPOHD POHD WHERE POHD.BUYER = B.BUYER AND POHD.PO_NO = B.PO_NO)) AS AGENT_CODE FROM ICOMIVDT A, ICOMPODT B WHERE A.INV_NO = #{inv_no} AND A.SELLER = #{seller} AND A.BUYER = #{buyer} AND A.STATUS != 'D' AND A.INV_QTY > 0 AND B.STATUS != 'D' AND B.SELLER = A.SELLER AND B.BUYER = A.BUYER AND B.PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND B.PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ ORDER BY 1, 2
